opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. Motion of respondent for leave to proceed informa pauperis granted. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioners is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Thursday, February 23, 1995. Brief of respondent is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Thursday, March 23, 1995. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
